title: Universal Transmitter: What It Operates
introduction:
The universal transmitter gives the Mustang a role in conveniences beyond the car itself. I think of it as the car's remote-control handshake with equipment at home or work.

This overview identifies its uses. Programming, compatibility checks and troubleshooting require separate instructions.

edits.text: Use the universal transmitter to operate garage doors, gates, and lighting and security systems at home or in the office.
edits.why: These are the equipment categories the transmitter serves; the overview is not a compatibility guarantee for every device in those categories.
